cohort_and_stratum: RCSB PDB 6OFB (2.84A human NADSYN1 octamer + NaAD/AMP/pyrophosphate [POP]) + AF-Q6IA69-F1 + GENCODE v46 MANE + gnomAD v4.1
assay_and_contrast: Exon-16 (chr11:71485542-71485648, aa 486-521) catalytic <=4.0A ligand-contact mapping + human autosomal recessive VCRL3 & salvage-pathway review
effect_estimate: PDB 6OFB (2.84A): Exon 16 (aa 486-521) directly encodes 6 catalytic <=4.0A contacts (NaAD/DND: Arg487 2.11A [2.84A crystal model], Gln498 3.48A, Leu510 3.11A, Leu511 3.56A; AMP: Arg489 3.14A, Ser515 3.83A); gnomAD v4.1 MANE LOEUF=1.010, pLI=4.63e-23
notes: GENCODE v46 MANE_Select ENST00000319023.7 (706 aa) maps Exon 15 (chr11:71484312-71484447, aa 440-485) and Exon 16 (chr11:71485542-71485648, 107 bp, aa 486-521) directly across TDP-43-retained Intron 15. In 2.84A human NADSYN1 PDB 6OFB (Chuenchor 2020 Nat Commun PMID:31911602; AF-Q6IA69-F1 mean pLDDT=95.92, 98.0% >=70), Chain A binds 20 residues <=4.0A to DND (NaAD+), 10 to AMP, and 6 to pyrophosphate (POP), with Arg487 (2.11A in 2.84A crystal model), Arg489, Gln498, Leu510, Leu511, and Ser515 inside Exon 16. Bi-allelic human LoF causes lethal autosomal recessive congenital NAD deficiency VCRL3 (OMIM 618845; Szot 2020 PMID:31883644, Szot 2024 PMID:38357931), while heterozygous LoF is tolerated (LOEUF=1.010, 80/95.4 obs/exp, missense Z=1.18). Zero occurrences in WO2023237638A1, WO2023222858A1, or Guo 2026 (PMID:42234776); supplemental splicing mention in Imaizumi 2022 (PMID:35641224) and cataloged in Sinha 2026 [Review] (PMID:42135847). Dominant NAMPT->NMNAT2 salvage redundancy gates therapeutic priority.

cohort_and_stratum: gnomAD v4.1 MANE ENST00000620254 + AF-Q96F07-F1 + paralog CYFIP1 WAVE regulatory complex PDB 3P8C (2.29A) + IP landscape
assay_and_contrast: Human pLoF/missense constraint, GENCODE v46 Exon 19-20 (MANE aa 694-755 / Q96F07-1 aa 719-780) & DEE65 Arg87 structural context, and chemical-SSO patent check
effect_estimate: gnomAD v4.1 MANE CYFIP2 pLI=1.000, LOEUF=0.274 (29/144.5 obs/exp), missense Z=6.94 (CYFIP1 LOEUF=0.440); AF-Q96F07-F1 mean pLDDT=86.81 (DEE65 Arg87=94.69, invariant across Q96F07-1/2); paralog WRC PDB 3P8C 2.29A
notes: gnomAD v4.1 MANE Select ENST00000620254 (UniProt Q96F07-2, 1,253 aa; canonical UniProt Q96F07-1 / AF-Q96F07-F1 has 1,278 aa due to an upstream 25-aa exon ENSE00003754054) ranks among the most LoF- and missense-constrained human synaptic genes (pLI=1.000, LOEUF=0.274, o/e=0.201, missense Z=6.94). Autosomal dominant variants (hotspot Arg87, AF-Q96F07-F1 pLDDT=94.69, invariant across isoforms) destabilize WAVE regulatory complex autoinhibition causing DEE65 (OMIM 618008, Nakashima 2018 PMID:29534297; autism-linked CYFIP2/NCKAP1 WRC structural modeling in Xie 2025 PMID:39660913; paralog CYFIP1 WRC 5-subunit X-ray PDB 3P8C 2.29A Chen 2010 PMID:21107423), while Brown 2022 full Intron 19 (2,692 bp, chr5:157328050-157330741) sits between MANE Exon 19 (aa 694-719) and Exon 20 (aa 719-755; Q96F07-1 aa 719-780). Supplemental TDP-43 splicing mention in Ma 2022 (PMID:35197626) and cataloged in Sinha 2026 [Review] (PMID:42135847); genus-listed without worked examples in U7 patent WO2023237638A1 and absent from standalone chemical-SSO claims.
